newsitem.title: CHINA: China lead output seen at 530,000 tonnes in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China lead output seen at 530,000 tonnes in 1997.

text.p: China's output of refined lead is expected to reach 530,000 tonnes in 1997, the Market Daily said on Thursday.
The newspaper did not give comparative figures.
China's output of regenerated lead is expected to reach 180,000 tonnes in 1997, it said.
Domestic demand for lead is expected to reach about 390,000 tonnes this year, up from 370,000 tonnes in 1996, it said.
China's lead exports were expected to fall this year because of rising inventories in the international market, it said, but gave no figures.
But exports were unlikely to show a big decline because China has already signed long-term supply contracts with a number of foreign countries, it said, but gave no further details.
China produced 227,300 tonnes of lead in the January-to-May period, down 1.5 percent compared with the same year-ago period, official media has reported.
